top5.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
top5.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation ends a turbulent period for Nvidia, after he transformed gaming chips into the engine of the artificial intelligence boom.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s resignation would create major succession risk at Nvidia, the dominant supplier at the center of the AI infrastructure boom, with likely repercussions across markets and the technology sector.

top5.title: Europe wants to ban dark patterns and loot boxes for minors
top5.description: The proposed Digital Fairness Act targets difficult-to-cancel subscriptions, addictive design, ads targeting minors, and personalized pricing, among other practices. Fines could reach 6% of global turnover.
top5.why: The proposed European Digital Fairness Act could impose major compliance costs and fines on digital businesses by restricting dark patterns, addictive design, targeted advertising to minors, and personalized pricing.

top5.title: U.S. Data Center Electricity Demand Is Growing Ten Times Faster Than the Grid
top5.description: U.S. data center electricity demand has increased by about 19% annually since 2000, compared with 2% for grid capacity. According to Howden, data centers may need to obtain up to 58% of their electricity off-grid by 2030.
top5.why: Data-center electricity demand is growing far faster than grid capacity, making power availability an increasingly important constraint on AI expansion, infrastructure investment, and corporate site selection.

top5.title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights
top5.description: United Airlines will block unauthorized third-party AI agents that attempt to book, purchase, or manage trips through its channels. The airline cites privacy, account security, and federal aviation regulations, among other reasons.
top5.why: United Airlines’ decision to block unauthorized AI booking agents signals that platforms may restrict autonomous agents over privacy, security, liability, and regulatory concerns, limiting their near-term distribution.

top5.title: Claude Launches Sheets, Whiteboards, and Narrated Data Videos
top5.description: Anthropic is launching Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, and Data, new workspace tools. Claude Data can connect to Snowflake and Salesforce to create dashboards, visual stories, or short narrated videos, while Sheets lets users build spreadsheets and Whiteboards enables collaboration on a shared board.
top5.why: Anthropic’s launch of Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, and Data expands the competitive battle from chatbots into enterprise workflows connected to systems such as Snowflake and Salesforce.
